description: Fetch docs, API references & syntax-extracted sections for packages/APIs/tools. Multi-source: 'auto' (smart fallback), 'official', 'docs.rs', 'pkg.go.dev', 'devdocs' (800+ tools/langs), 'mdn' (Web standards), 'javadoc', 'context7', 'npm', 'pypi'.

cache.description: Use the 24h local docs cache (default 'default') or bypass/refresh it with 'reload'

library.description: Library, package, middleware, or Web API name (e.g. 'react', 'fastapi', 'tokio', 'redis', 'docker', 'fetch', 'Array.prototype.map', 'org.apache.commons:commons-lang3'). Also supports ecosystem prefixes like 'crates:tokio', 'go:gin', 'mdn:fetch', 'devdocs:redis', 'javadoc:com.google.guava:guava' or Context7 library ID (e.g. '/vercel/next.js')

limit.description: Maximum number of code snippets or sections to return (default 5)

query.description: The specific topic, method, command, or question to get relevant documentation for (e.g. 'hset', 'useMemo', 'middleware', 'asyncio'). For long documents (>8000 chars), syntax-level section extraction is performed, keeping the preamble (imports/setup) and targeted section intact.

source.description: Documentation source: 'auto' (smart routing & cascade fallback: Context7 -> Official Site -> DevDocs -> Registry), 'official' (standalone doc site), 'docs.rs' (Rust crates), 'pkg.go.dev' (Go packages), 'devdocs' (800+ middleware & languages: Redis, Docker, Nginx, Python, C++, etc.), 'mdn' (MDN Web Docs: JS, Web APIs, CSS), 'rfc' (IETF/RFC standards: HTTP, TLS, QUIC, JSON, etc.), 'javadoc' (Javadoc.io for Maven packages), 'context7' (Context7 LLM doc index), 'npm', 'pypi', 'github' (registry fallback)

strict.description: If true, rejects low-confidence matches with an error instead of returning loosely matched candidate docs or alternative libraries (default false)

version.description: Optional explicit version for consistent multi-source pinning (e.g. '18.2.0', '3.11', '1.38.0', 'v1.9.1'). Overrides an @version embedded in library

name: queryDocs
